name: Leaflet Love Story
source:
A normal male engineering student who used to be successful, is now languishing at the bottom in his English classes.

A pretty girl who is said to be unapproachable, and is very proud of herself,
how will the romance between the two of them develop?

In order to force someone to learn English well, a friendship that is neither too close nor distant develops.

Will it lead to giving up on it, or to hold the girl's hand tightly without letting go?
Which choice will you make!?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/895220/Leaflet_Love_Story/]Steam[/url]]
